description: Bulk-match an array of advertiser/company domains against StartupHub.ai's startup database. Returns per-domain whether the company is in our database, plus funding amount, latest round, investor IDs, sectors, founded date, and HQ country. Built for cross-reference workflows like 'what % of Google Ads / Taboola / Outbrain advertisers are VC-backed': pass a scraped advertiser list, get back the funding intel. Up to 100 domains per call, 1 db credit per request (only charged when matches found). Needs a free StartupHub.ai account.

domains.description: Array of advertiser/company domains. Accepts raw URLs (https://www.example.com), stripped (example.com), with or without paths. Max 100 per call.
